title: Business Account Agreement, Holding Clause: One Northgate Business Invoice Account (Net Terms) per Business Profile
content:
**Holding clause — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)**

1. **One account at a time.** A business profile may hold 1 Northgate Business invoice account at a time.
2. **Acceptance of a new application.** A new application is accepted only when the business has no other invoice account in applied, active or credit hold status.
3. **Change of terms tier.** Changing terms tier is done on the existing account at a review; it is not done by opening a second account.
4. **Basis of the judgement.** Whether the business already holds an invoice account, and in which status, is read from Northgate's account records for that customer profile at the time of the application. The test looks at every other invoice account held under the same customer profile as the one applying.

### Status of another account held by the same profile

| Status of the other invoice account on record | Effect on a new application under clause 2 |
|---|---|
| Applied (application pending) | Not accepted |
| Active | Not accepted |
| Credit hold | Not accepted |
| Closed | Does not stand in the way under clause 2 |
| Declined | Does not stand in the way under clause 2 |

### Illustrations (hypothetical profiles)

- *Profile A* holds a Net 30 Standard account that is on credit hold and applies for a new account: the new application is not accepted, because an account in credit hold status is on record.
- *Profile B* once held an invoice account that is now closed and holds no other: clause 2 does not stand in the way of a new application.
- *Profile C* holds an active Net 15 account and wishes to move to Net 30 Standard: under clause 3, the change of terms tier is done on the existing Net 15 account at a review.
